component.name: OpenCRT
component.summary: SSH, Telnet, serial and remote desktop client

description.p: OpenCRT is a tabbed terminal client with a session manager. It connects over SSH, Telnet, rlogin, serial ports and raw sockets, opens local shells, and shows RDP and VNC desktops in tabs.

ul.li: SFTP file transfers, port forwarding and X11 forwarding
Session logs, terminal recording and keyword highlighting
Rhai and Python scripts, button bars and command windows
Settings Sync between computers through a git repository

description.p: Local shell tabs run on the host system, outside the sandbox.
